items.primary_title: KEYNOTE-867: A Phase III, Randomized, Double-Blind Study of Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy With Pembrolizumab for Unresected Stage I or II Non–Small Cell Lung Cancer
items.population: 448 adults with untreated inoperable or surgery-refusing stage I/II NSCLC; SBRT+pembrolizumab n=227, SBRT+placebo n=221.
items.intervention: Thoracic SBRT to primary tumour over ≤2 weeks plus pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 3 weeks for up to 17 cycles.
items.comparator: Same SBRT plus placebo every 3 weeks for up to 17 cycles.
items.primary_endpoint: EFS by blinded independent central review
items.follow_up: Median follow-up 20.6 months at first prespecified interim analysis; study treatment discontinued after premature stop.
items.efficacy: Median EFS 31.2 vs28.3 months; HR0.92 (95% CI0.69–1.24), P=.2932. Median time to death or distant metastasis 39.1 vs41.3 months; HR1.02 (0.74–1.42). OS median54.7 vs not reached; HR1.33 (0.93–1.90), not confirmatory.
items.safety: Grade3–5 treatment-related AEs 46/226 (20.4%) vs8/218 (3.7%); five treatment-related deaths (2.2%) in pembrolizumab arm, none in placebo.
items.reason: No EFS benefit and substantially higher grade3–5 toxicity and treatment-related deaths; trial stopped early for unfavorable benefit-risk.
items.nccn_provenance: not verified — official complete guideline/reference list inaccessible
items.next_action: Retain as contrary/negative evidence; do not create a canonical trial page unless later guideline recommendation context makes it essential.

items.reason: Negative interim non-inferiority result with concerning OS imbalance; trial stopped early. No DOI/PMID or full primary abstract metadata identified; retain as contrary evidence, not a new page.
